name: settings-01
title: 设置页
description: 用方条控件拼成的完整设置页：分区导航、实时预览、已修改计数、恢复默认与异步保存。

files.content:
import type { Settings01SectionId, Settings01Values } from "./types"

/**
 * 设置页所有用户可见的文案。
 * 含 {count}、{value}、{section} 的文案在渲染时由 formatLabel 填入实际值。

const DEFAULT_LABELS = {

  navLabel: "设置分区",

  // 分区名（导航与面板）
  sectionAppearance: "外观",

  // 窄屏顶部分段选择里的短名，宽度有限所以单独一份

  navEditor: "编辑器",
  navPrivacy: "隐私",
  // 分区说明
  descriptionAppearance: "主题、强调色与界面尺寸，右侧预览会实时变化",
  descriptionNotifications: "决定哪些事件会打扰你，以及什么时候不打扰",
  descriptionSound: "音量、按键音效与触感反馈",
  descriptionEditor: "缩进、行高与空白字符的显示方式",
  descriptionPrivacy: "谁能看到你，以及我们收集哪些数据",
  // 面板头部

  panelDefault: "全部为默认值",
  copySection: "复制本分区设置",
  copiedSection: "已复制",
  resetSection: "恢复本分区默认值",
  // 外观
  groupTheme: "主题",
  groupShape: "尺寸与形状",
  groupMotion: "动态",
  theme: "主题模式",
  themeLight: "浅色",
  themeDark: "深色",
  themeSystem: "跟随系统",
  accent: "强调色",
  fontSize: "界面字号",
  radius: "圆角",
  density: "信息密度",
  densityCompact: "紧凑",
  densityComfortable: "舒适",
  densitySpacious: "宽松",
  reduceMotion: "减少动态效果",
  reduceMotionHint: "关闭动画",
  readoutPx: "{value}px",
  // 预览卡片

  previewHeading: "本周回顾",
  previewBody: "已完成 12 项任务，比上周多 3 项。",
  previewAction: "查看详情",
  previewProgress: "进度",
  previewLive: "实时",
  previewModeLight: "浅色",
  previewModeDark: "深色",
  previewModeSystem: "跟随系统",
  // 通知
  groupChannels: "通知渠道",
  groupQuiet: "免打扰",
  notifications: "允许通知",
  notificationsHint: "总开关",
  notifyMentions: "提及我",
  notifyMentionsHint: "有人 @ 我时",
  notifyReplies: "评论回复",

  notifyUpdates: "产品动态",

  // 声音与触感
  groupVolume: "音量",
  groupFeedback: "反馈",

type Settings01Labels = { [Key in keyof typeof DEFAULT_LABELS]: string }

/** 出厂默认值。组件的「已修改」判断、恢复默认和未受控时的初始值都以它为准。 */
const DEFAULT_VALUES: Settings01Values = {
  theme: "system",
  accent: "primary",
  fontSize: 14,
  radius: 10,
  density: "comfortable",
  reduceMotion: false,
  notifications: true,
  notifyMentions: true,
  notifyReplies: true,
  notifyEmail: false,
  notifyUpdates: false,
  quietHours: [22, 31],
  volume: 60,
  keySound: false,
  soundTheme: "soft",
  haptics: true,
  indent: "2",
  lineHeight: 1.6,
  showTabs: false,
  visibility: "team",
  analytics: true,
  crashReports: true,
  retention: 90,
}

/** 分区的显示顺序 */
const SECTION_IDS: readonly Settings01SectionId[] = [
  "appearance",
  "notifications",
  "sound",
  "editor",
  "privacy",
]

/** 每个分区管哪些设置项：分区计数、分区复制与分区恢复默认都按它来。 */
const SECTION_KEYS: Record<Settings01SectionId, readonly (keyof Settings01Values)[]> =
  {
    appearance: [
      "theme",
      "accent",
      "fontSize",
      "radius",
      "density",
      "reduceMotion",
    ],
    notifications: [
      "notifications",
      "notifyMentions",
      "notifyReplies",
      "notifyEmail",
      "notifyUpdates",
      "quietHours",
    ],
    sound: ["volume", "keySound", "soundTheme", "haptics"],
    editor: ["indent", "lineHeight", "showTabs"],
    privacy: ["visibility", "analytics", "crashReports", "retention"],
  }

/** 每个分区用到的文案键：完整名称、说明与窄屏短名。 */
const SECTION_LABEL_KEYS: Record<
  Settings01SectionId,
  {
    title: keyof Settings01Labels
    description: keyof Settings01Labels
    nav: keyof Settings01Labels
  }
> = {
  appearance: {
    title: "sectionAppearance",
    description: "descriptionAppearance",
    nav: "navAppearance",
  },
  notifications: {
    title: "sectionNotifications",
    description: "descriptionNotifications",
    nav: "navNotifications",
  },
  sound: {
    title: "sectionSound",
    description: "descriptionSound",
    nav: "navSound",
  },
  editor: {
    title: "sectionEditor",
    description: "descriptionEditor",
    nav: "navEditor",
  },
  privacy: {
    title: "sectionPrivacy",
    description: "descriptionPrivacy",
    nav: "navPrivacy",
  },
}

/** 合并用户传入的文案与默认文案。 */
function resolveLabels(labels?: Partial<Settings01Labels>): Settings01Labels {
  return { ...DEFAULT_LABELS, ...labels }
}

/** 把文案里的 {key} 占位符替换成实际值，例如「已修改 {count} 项」。 */
function formatLabel(
  template: string,
  values: Record<string, string | number>,
): string {
  return Object.entries(values).reduce(
    (text, [key, value]) => text.replaceAll(`{${key}}`, String(value)),
    template,
  )
}

export {
  DEFAULT_LABELS,
  DEFAULT_VALUES,
  SECTION_IDS,
  SECTION_KEYS,
  SECTION_LABEL_KEYS,
  formatLabel,
  resolveLabels,
}
export type { Settings01Labels }

type ThemeMode = "light" | "dark" | "system"
type Density = "compact" | "comfortable" | "spacious"
type SoundTheme = "soft" | "crisp" | "mechanical"
type IndentWidth = "2" | "4" | "tab"
type ProfileVisibility = "public" | "team" | "private"

/** 设置页的全部取值。键按分区归类，见 config.ts 的 SECTION_KEYS。 */
type Settings01Values = {
  // 外观
  theme: ThemeMode
  /** 强调色，取值是 tone-picker 的色调名（primary、blue……）或任意 CSS 颜色 */
  accent: string
  /** 界面字号（px） */
  fontSize: number
  /** 圆角（px） */
  radius: number
  density: Density
  reduceMotion: boolean
  // 通知
  notifications: boolean
  notifyMentions: boolean
  notifyReplies: boolean
  notifyEmail: boolean
  notifyUpdates: boolean
  /** 免打扰时段 [起点, 终点]，单位小时，范围 12–36（36 即次日 12:00），读数按 24 小时取模 */
  quietHours: [number, number]
  // 声音与触感
  volume: number
  keySound: boolean
  soundTheme: SoundTheme
  haptics: boolean
  // 编辑器
  indent: IndentWidth
  lineHeight: number
  showTabs: boolean
  // 隐私
  visibility: ProfileVisibility
  analytics: boolean
  crashReports: boolean
  /** 历史记录保留天数 */
  retention: number
}

type Settings01SectionId =
  | "appearance"
  | "notifications"
  | "sound"
  | "editor"
  | "privacy"

export type {
  Density,
  IndentWidth,
  ProfileVisibility,
  Settings01SectionId,
  Settings01Values,
  SoundTheme,
  ThemeMode,
}
